listing.name: Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe — MKVDCU-Recomp (KawaiiBunga)
listing.summary: The project reports full Arcade matches at 60 FPS on one GTX1650SUPER. Other modes and long sessions remain untested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own complete extracted Xbox 360 Mortal Kombat vs. DC Universe files, including the original retail XEX. The README abbreviates its SHA256; this guide does not include the full supported hash.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the MKVDCU launcher with your own original retail game folder. It installs the tools and compiles the game locally.

warnings: The project reports full Arcade matches at 60 FPS on one GTX1650SUPER. Other modes and long sessions remain untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
